flipToBack.timing: RequiredGameTextTriggerAction on TriggerConditions.isTableChanged (automatic; note: NOT marked setSingletonTrigger unlike most objectives)
flipToBack.prose: Flip if Tracked Fleet is 'blown away' ('annihilated' in card text; engine models it as blown-away state). Playtest card (ExpansionSet.PLAYTESTING, setTestingText).

children.req: blown-away state: a card matching filter is 'blown away' (modifiersQuerying.isBlownAway)

flipToFront.prose: The back NEVER flips back to front: Card501_060_BACK.java contains no FlipCardEffect and no flip trigger. Instead the back carries a hard-lose: place Objective out of play if Kylo was just forfeited to Lost Pile from Salt Plateau (where Han, Leia, or Luke present) during a battle you lost.
citations: src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/java/com/gempukku/swccgo/cards/set501/dark/Card501_060_BACK.java:92-127 (required triggers: out-of-play + retrieval cancel only, no flip)

requirementSemantics: flipToBack: blown-away card-state semantics (GameConditions.isBlownAway on Filters.Tracked_Fleet). Not control, occupy, or presence; a one-way state latch achieved by 'annihilating' (blowing away) the owner's own starting Epic Event/target Tracked Fleet.

BACK hard-lose: timing trigger TriggerConditions.justForfeitedToLostPileFromLocation(game, effectResult, Filters.Kylo, Filters.and(Filters.Crait_Salt_Plateau, Filters.wherePresent(self, Filters.or(Filters.Han, Filters.Leia, Filters.Luke)))) AND GameConditions.isDuringBattleLostBy(game, playerId): forfeit-state + battle-outcome semantics.

BACK retrieval lock: control-with semantics: GameConditions.controlsWith(game, self, playerId, Filters.Crait_Salt_Plateau, Filters.Kylo) gates auto-cancel of opponent Force retrieval (required trigger on isAboutToRetrieveForce).

BACK drain bonus: occupies-with semantics: OccupiesWithCondition(self, playerId, Filters.Crait_location, Filters.Kylo) plus locations Filters.and(Filters.battleground, Filters.occupiesWith(playerId, self, Filters.and(Filters.First_Order_character, Filters.with(self, Filters.First_Order_character)))).
BACK drain lock on opponent: ControlsWithCondition(self, playerId, Filters.Crait_Salt_Plateau, Filters.Kylo) + opponent characterOrPermanentPilotAlone at location.
typedIdentities: Filters.Tracked_Fleet (flip state target; required start deploy)
Filters.or(Filters.Bow_To_The_First_Order, Filters.and(Filters.your(self), Filters.hasAbilityOrHasPermanentPilotWithAbility, Filters.not(Icon.EPISODE_VII))) (owner deploy ban, remainder of game)

Filters.or(Filters.titleContains("Supremacy"), Filters.and(Icon.EPISODE_VII, Filters.battleground)) (once-per-turn download, front AND back, shared GameTextActionId.THE_FIRST_ORDER_REIGNS__DOWNLOAD_EPISODE_7_BATTLEGROUND)

setupAndPullRoutes: START OF GAME (front, all required): deploy D'Qar system (Filters.Dqar_system) [Card501_060.java:49-55]; Crait system (Filters.Crait_system) [56-62]; Salt Plateau (Filters.Crait_Salt_Plateau) [63-69]; Tracked Fleet (Filters.Tracked_Fleet) [70-76]

FRONT+BACK, once per turn (shared action id): deploy from Reserve Deck a card with 'Supremacy' in title or an [Episode VII] battleground: DeployCardFromReserveDeckEffect(Filters.or(Filters.titleContains("Supremacy"), Filters.and(Icon.EPISODE_VII, Filters.battleground)), true) [Card501_060.java:91-111, Card501_060_BACK.java:51-66]

BACK, once per turn: deploy a non-unique trooper or non-unique [First Order] vehicle from LOST PILE: DeployCardFromLostPileEffect(Filters.or(nonUniqueTrooper, nonUniqueFOVehicle), false), GameTextActionId.THE_RESISTANCE_IS_DOOMED__DOWNLOAD_FIRST_ORDER_VEHICLE_OR_TROOPER [Card501_060_BACK.java:68-87]
otherObligations: FRONT after-deployment, REMAINDER OF GAME: owner may not deploy Bow To The First Order or own cards with ability except [Episode VII] cards: MayNotDeployModifier(Filters.or(Filters.Bow_To_The_First_Order, Filters.and(Filters.your(self), Filters.hasAbilityOrHasPermanentPilotWithAbility, Filters.not(Icon.EPISODE_VII))), playerId) [Card501_060.java:81-88]
FRONT: opponent loses no more than 1 Force from your Force drains at systems: LimitForceLossFromForceDrainModifier(self, Filters.system, 1, opponent) [Card501_060.java:119]
